**What problem would this solve?**
A clear description of the gap or friction you ran into.

**Proposed approach (if you have one)**
How you'd imagine this working, or a link to a similar module elsewhere
in the template for reference.

**Note on how new modules get adopted**
Per [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) and
[`adr/003-backport-after-confirmation.md`](../../adr/003-backport-after-confirmation.md),
a genuinely new module is only merged into the shared template once
confirmed on at least two independent projects (or proven to be a
no-op) — this issue is a good place to start that conversation, even if
it doesn't lead to an immediate merge.
